title: Minimum Interval to Include Each Query
summary: Given intervals defined by their start and end points, determine the size of the smallest interval that includes each query value.
statement: Given intervals defined by their start and end points, determine the size of the smallest interval that includes each query value. If no interval includes the query, return -1. Return an array of answers corresponding to each query.
constraints: Intervals and containment are inclusive; interval size is right-left+1.
For each query return the smallest containing interval size, or -1 if none.
hints: Sweep queries from left to right while adding intervals that have begun.
Use a heap ordered by interval size and discard heap tops that ended before the query.
The remaining heap top is the smallest active containing interval.
Every interval is inserted once when its left endpoint becomes eligible; expired intervals cannot answer later queries, so the heap minimum is exactly optimal.
editorial: Every interval is inserted once when its left endpoint becomes eligible; expired intervals cannot answer later queries, so the heap minimum is exactly optimal.

tests.explanation: The minimum sizes are three, three, one, and four.
The queries receive sizes two, -1, four, and six.
